question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94416 the canonical fix for this Matrix missing-key recovery issue and supersede the broader overlapping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94044 path?
rationale: Current main still has the source-visible retry gap, and the open PRs choose different scopes: 94416 fixes the Matrix decrypt retry owner with live proof, while 94044 changes broader sync recoverability and has existing risk notes.

options.title: Use PR 94416 as canonical
options.body: Review and land the focused decrypt-bridge retry-state fix, then close this issue as implemented and resolve the broader overlapping PR as superseded.

options.title: Request an API seam first
options.body: Ask the PR author to reshape the retry through a maintainer-approved Matrix SDK/API boundary before merge.

options.title: Pause for a different approach
options.body: Keep this issue open and reject both open PR shapes if maintainers want a separate Matrix recovery design or live-current-main repro first.

recommendation.title: Use PR 94416 as canonical
recommendation.body: Review and land the focused decrypt-bridge retry-state fix, then close this issue as implemented and resolve the broader overlapping PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest Matrix feature-history signal across the decrypt bridge and sync lifecycle surfaces involved in the decision.
